# Amir Iqbal Khan — 404 Tech

> Amir Iqbal Khan is a full stack developer and the founder of 404 Tech, based in Pakistan. He designs and builds digital products end to end — web applications, AI-powered experiences, creative websites, developer tools, and ecommerce storefronts. This site is his working portfolio and a written account of how he builds software.

## Primary entities

- [Amir Iqbal Khan](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#about): full stack developer, founder of 404 Tech, based in Pakistan. Works across Next.js, React, TypeScript, AI integration, and system design.
- [404 Tech](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#studio): independent studio shipping modern websites, web applications, ecommerce, and AI-powered digital products.

## What I build

- [Digital products](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#work): web applications built from architecture through interfaces, APIs, data, auth, and deployment.
- [AI experiences](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#work): AI-powered applications, intelligent workflows, multimodal experiences, and vision systems.
- [Creative websites](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#work): typography, motion, interaction, and visual storytelling on the modern frontend.
- [Developer tools](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#work): tooling that improves how developers build, experiment, and work with technology.
- [Ecommerce experiences](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#work): product presentation, usability, interaction, and performance for digital commerce.

## Engineering approach

- [How I build software end to end](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#approach): the architecture pass, interface decisions, AI integration, Core Web Vitals as a design constraint, and what happens after launch.
- [Focus areas](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#focus): Next.js ecosystems, AI integration, creative development, and system design.
- [Currently building](https://aamir404tech.vercel.app/#now): developer-focused products, AI-augmented web experiences, and immersive digital experiences.
